newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 140 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 140 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 140-billion-bolivar auction of 178-, 268- and 359-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 22.04 percent.

The bank said it would offer 80 billion bolivars worth of 178-day bills with a nominal interest rate of 20.94 percent, 30 billion bolivars of 268-day bills at 21.48 percent, and 30 billion bolivars of 359-day bills at 22.04 percent.
At its auction last week the central bank sold 117 billion bolivars of 177-, 268- and 357-day bills with yields of 20.93, 23.05 and 24.13 percent, respectively.
